name: Stool Eleven
story: Eleven stools, one cook, and a handwritten menu that changes when he runs out of broth. Locals line up by six. Nobody posted about it.
order: The oxtail noodle soup. Ask for it extra peppery.

name: The Lamplighter Room
story: Behind an unmarked green door, lit entirely by oil lamps. The bartender invents drinks from whatever mood you walk in with.
order: Whatever she hands you. Tell her one word about your day.

name: Coal & Crumb
story: A former coal-yard office turned two-table bakery. Twelve loaves a morning, gone by nine, baked by a retired shipwright.
order: The burnt-honey rye, still warm. Arrive before eight.

name: The Truck Behind the Truck
story: Parked behind a tire shop, no sign, cash only. The al pastor spit has been turning since before the neighborhood changed.
order: Three al pastor, extra pineapple, salsa verde.
